title: Blood Resonance
next_chapter_hook: Just as the Demonic Path Commander's divine sense dissipated, in a certain secret realm thousands of miles away, a pair of eyes identical to Chen Nian's slowly opened, the corner of her lips curving into a meaningful arc—the ruins, she was determined to obtain them.

text.content: The excruciating pain from his chest caused Chen Ji's body to shudder. The Tianji Record Fragment suddenly emanated an eerie blood-red glow, like an ancient book soaked through with blood. Deep within his Mental Sea, an unprecedented power was awakening—that feeling... as if some long-dormant bloodline had finally found a frequency to resonate with.

The scene in his Mental Sea gradually sharpened—it was a battlefield shrouded in blood-red mist, with boundless demonic energy surging like a tide. And at the core of that demonic energy stood a proud figure. She wore a black robe, surrounded by eerie crimson patterns, her features bearing a startling seven-point resemblance to Chen Nian, yet carrying an even more domineering sharpness.

dialogue.content: (Inhaling sharply) The Demonic Path Commander... she and Niannian...

text.content: Just as Chen Ji tried to see more clearly, that figure suddenly turned her head, as if peering across infinite void to meet his gaze. A boundless divine sense swept over him like a monstrous wave, carrying irresistible pressure and a bone-chilling probing intent, piercing directly into the depths of Chen Ji's Mental Sea.

dialogue.content: (Groaning in pain, his Mental Sea in agony) Such powerful divine sense attack... she found me!

text.content: Just as that divine sense was about to tear through Chen Ji's Mental Sea, a幽-purple light suddenly bloomed, completely shielding the black divine sense attack. Ye Qing's figure appeared beside Chen Ji凭空, a诡异魔纹 appearing on her brow center, emanating the unique aura of 'Demonic Path Mist'.

dialogue.content: (Withdrawing divine sense, expression grave) Fortunately I sensed it in time. That Lady made a personal probe... What did you see in the Tianji Record?
(Suppressing the surging qi and blood, voice hoarse) I saw the Demonic Path Commander... she's still alive. And her face... resembles my missing sister...

text.content: Ye Qing's eyes sharply narrowed, the demonic energy around her fluctuating intensely. She fell silent for a moment before finally speaking, her voice carrying a rare gravity: 'Fated Twin Born... so that's how it is.'

dialogue.content: 'Fated Twin Born?' Chen Ji's voice suddenly rose. 'Are you saying there's a blood resonance between the Demonic Path Commander and my sister?'

text.content: Ye Qing slowly nodded, her 幽紫 eyes flickering with complex light: 'The Holy Sect's ancient records do contain such记载. Legend has it that Heavenly Fate Keys do not exist alone, but appear in pairs. One governs life, the other governs death, they nurture yet oppose each other, yet are fated to be connected. Your sister was taken by the Holy Sect... she's probably being used as a tool to activate the Fated Twin Born body.'

dialogue.content: (A cold light flashing in his eyes) A tool? Niannian...

text.content: Ye Qing's words struck Chen Ji like a thunderbolt. The pain in his chest surged again, the Tianji Record's glow growing even more intense, as if corroborating something. He gripped the fragment tightly, his knuckles white, fingernails digging deep into his palms.

choice.prompt: Faced with this sudden truth, Chen Ji must make a choice: confront this destined confrontation, or choose to endure and lie low?

choices.description: Since there's no escaping it, I'll face it head-on. The fated twins are destined to battle eventually—better I take the initiative.
choices.visible_cost: Exposing the Tianji Record Fragment's aura may attract the Demonic Path Commander's attention
choices.visible_reward: Gain the Demonic Path Commander's attention, buy time for plotting
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Path Commander's strength is unfathomable, direct confrontation carries enormous risk

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and abruptly released his suppression of the Tianji Record's aura. In an instant, a faint golden light emanated from his body, resonating with the blood-red demonic energy in the distance. In his Mental Sea, that proud figure seemed to sense something, the corner of her lips curving into an amused arc.

choices.memory_label: 陈机展现出直面命运的决心

choices.description: Now is not the time. The Demonic Path Commander's power far exceeds imagination—I need more preparation to take the initiative in this chess game.
choices.visible_cost: Temporarily abandon leads on tracking Chen Nian
choices.visible_reward: Preserve strength, wait for the optimal moment
choices.risk_hint: The March 7th countdown will not stop

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes narrowed, forcibly suppressing the restless power within him. The Tianji Record's glow gradually dimmed, and that proud figure seemed to lose interest, her divine sense ebbing like a tide. But he knew this was only temporary calm—the deadliest silence often comes before the storm.

choices.memory_label: 陈机选择了隐忍，但内心更加坚定

text.content: Ye Qing watched Chen Ji quietly, the demonic energy around her slowly subsiding. She could sense the change in this man before her—that coldness seeping from his bones reminded her of her former self. 'You want to save your sister,' she suddenly spoke up, 'I can help you.'

dialogue.content: 'But you must understand, the bond between fated twins cannot be easily severed. The Holy Sect controls her precisely by exploiting this bloodline connection. To break the situation... you must become stronger than her.'

choice.prompt: Ye Qing's proposal left Chen Ji deep in thought—what did her help mean? In this chess game, what role was she playing?

choices.description: Ye Qing's goals align with mine. She needs to escape Holy Sect control, I need to rescue Niannian. The enemy of my enemy is my friend.
choices.visible_cost: Expose more weaknesses to the other party
choices.visible_reward: Gain the Demonic Path Saint's intelligence network and the protection of Demonic Path Mist
choices.risk_hint: Whether Ye Qing can be fully trusted remains uncertain

dialogue.content: (Nodding, eyes determined) Very well. But let me make this clear first—whoever so much as touches a single hair of Niannian's, I will make the entire Holy Sect pay.

choices.description: Ye Qing's help came too suddenly. Before I fully understand her background, I cannot easily trust anyone.
choices.visible_cost: May lose an important intelligence source
choices.visible_reward: Maintain initiative,不被 anyone lead by the nose
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may因此产生 distance

dialogue.content: (With a knowing smile) I appreciate Ye Qing's kindness. But before we cooperate, I'd like to know... why do you want to help me?

choices.memory_label: 对夜清保持戒备，试探她的真实意图

text.content: Ye Qing looked at Chen Ji's scrutinizing gaze, the corner of her lips curving into a smile instead: 'You're quite cautious... that's good.' She paused, 'I help you because we're both merely pieces on the Holy Sect's chessboard. Instead of waiting to be sacrificed, we might as well work together to overturn this game.'

Just then, the Tianji Record Fragment shuddered violently once more. A divine sense impact even more intense than before pierced through Ye Qing's protection, like a blade stabbing directly into Chen Ji's Mental Sea. This time, that proud figure was no longer merely probing, but carrying tangible killing intent.

dialogue.content: (Expression drastically changing) Not good! That Lady has truly angered—she's locked onto you!

choice.prompt: The Demonic Path Commander's divine sense lock felt like a thorn in his back. Chen Ji must make a choice: resist with full strength, or use the Tianji Record's ability to take the initiative?

choices.description: Take this hit head-on! Even if injured, I cannot show cowardice before her—never lose momentum!
choices.visible_cost: Endure the divine sense impact, Mental Sea damaged
choices.visible_reward: Prove your value to the Demonic Path Commander, making her interested rather than dismissive
choices.risk_hint: May cause serious divine sense damage

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly mobilized all his True Qi, condensing a golden barrier in his Mental Sea. The Demonic Path Commander's divine sense crashed against it like a raging tide, the sound of clashing metal exploding in his mind. Blood seeped from his seven apertures, yet he stubbornly endured, the corner of his lips actually curving into a cold smile.

choices.memory_label: 陈机以血肉之躯硬抗魔道主帅的神识攻击，展现出惊人意志

choices.description: The best defense is offense! Use the Tianji Record's power to trace her divine sense backward—let her know I'm no pushover!
choices.visible_cost: Consume a large amount of Heavenly Fate Value
choices.visible_reward: Trace the Demonic Path Commander's aura backward, gain crucial clues about Chen Nian's location
choices.risk_hint: May thoroughly infuriate the Demonic Path Commander, bringing even bigger trouble

text.content: A fierce light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes as the Tianji Record suddenly blazed with dazzling golden light. Using the fragment as a medium, he actively surged against the divine sense current upstream, leaving a single sentence in the Demonic Path Commander's Mental Sea—'Chen Nian is mine. Whoever dares touch her will pay a hundredfold!'

choices.memory_label: 陈机以天机录向魔道主帅宣战

text.content: After a moment of silence, a ethereal laugh echoed through his Mental Sea. That laughter carried three parts amusement, three parts appreciation, and four parts chilling interest. 'Interesting... the Tianqing Sect actually hides such a character.' That voice was like orchids in an empty valley, yet permeated with bone-piercing coldness. 'March 7th... I shall come personally to see what qualification you have to say such words.'

The divine sense connection abruptly severed. Chen Ji felt his mind go blank. The Tianji Record's glow completely faded, and he knelt on one knee, gasping heavily. But the corner of his lips slowly curved into a meaningful arc—the first step, successful. The Demonic Path Commander had become interested in him, and interest... is where cracks begin.

dialogue.content: (Reaching out to help Chen Ji up, eyes full of shock) Are you insane? Declaring war on that Lady directly... Do you have any idea what kind of existence she is?

(Wiping the blood from the corner of his lips, calmly smiling) Of course I know. But precisely because I know how strong she is... I must make her come personally. The March 7th ruins—this is the first chess move I've made.

text.content: Ye Qing stared blankly at this man covered in blood yet smiling nonchalantly, an indescribable emotion welling up in her heart. She suddenly understood why the Holy Sect considered both the 'Heavenly Fate Key' and the 'Tianji Record Holder' as threats—these two people together are simply too dangerous. 'What are you planning to do?' she asked, her voice carrying an anticipation she herself hadn't noticed.

dialogue.content: (Gazing toward the distant horizon, a sharp gleam flickering in his eyes) Since she wants to come, then let her come. The gears of fate have already begun to turn—this chess game, it's time for me to be the Chess Player. Niannian, wait for your brother.
